_meta._note: Tool parameters only. The playable province list is NOT here: it is read from tools/coverage/params.json#pipeline.studyArea.provinces (same list as the coverage survey). The OSM source (D1) and projected CRS also come from that file. The mask hole is built from the play-area edge lines of the border step, so it uses borders.playableSimplify_m and borders.playableCoordinatePrecision (one geometry for the line and the hole).

launchArea._note: P2-H01: launch districts of D-083 (HUMAN 2026-09-25). `id` is the stable id used by client, content and telemetry; the osmRelationId set must equal tools/coverage/analysis/launch-score.config.json#launchDistricts (test_launch_outputs checks it). Names shown to players come from content, not from this file.

playableProvinces._note: P2-F04-T23 (P1-X39): small committed polygon per playable province so tools/tiles/bin/verify-bbox.py runs in CI without tools/coverage/out/. input is relative to tools/coverage/ (git-ignored pipeline output); output is committed.

_source.borders.simplify_m: map-style 6.3 suggests ~200 m for all 77 provinces. On the 2026-09-01 extract with 20 m lines around the play area: 300 m gives 292 KB, 350 m gives 260 KB (15% headroom under the 300 KB budget, A-P1-H01-2). About 1 px at z8. Applies only to lines not touching a playable province.
_source.mask.clipBbox: map-style 6.2 / screen S6 (P2-F04-T23): the province relations of Samut Prakan and Samut Sakhon reach 13.219 N in the Gulf, south of the tile bbox (13.4 N). Without tiles the style background is black, so an unclipped hole showed a black edge across the sea at 13.4 N. The hole is cut with the tile bbox itself (pointer, never a copy); null disables the cut (tests).
_source.borders.playableSimplify_m: map-style 6.2 (~20 m): lines touching a playable province, including the mask hole
_source.launchArea.simplify_m: P2-H01: the launch-area test only runs for players already 'far' from every open dungeon (tech note F06 section 9), so 10 m is well below any decision it feeds, and half the play-area edge tolerance. Shared district edges are simplified once (same method as borders), so there is no gap or overlap between districts.
_source.playableProvinces.simplify_m: P2-F04-T23: only feeds a bbox sanity check (which reads the exact outward-rounded bbox property, not the geometry) and an optional pmtiles --region; the geometry is buffered by the same 100 m so it always contains the original.
_source.launchArea.maxFileBytes: P2-H01 brief: well under 100 KB; 50 KB leaves room for more districts in later rounds
